During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]],<ref name="Praji" /> a conflict that lasted from [[3681 BBY]] to [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]] in the [[Coruscant sector/Legends|Coruscant sector]] was '''attacked''' by the forces of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Praji" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle at Kaikielius was first mentioned in ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', a in-universe history article written by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published online in the exclusive [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] fan club on [[February 5]], [[2009]]. The article does not specify who won the battle or when it occurred beyond placing it in the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Praji" />
